summary: This study reports the atomic layer deposition (ALD) of HfO2 films using tetrakis(tetrahydroborato)hafnium (Hf(BH4)4) and water as precursors. The films were deposited at temperatures between 100 and 175 °C, where self-limiting growth was observed. The as-deposited films consisted of an amorphous mixture of HfO2 and B2O3, with lower density and refractive index compared to pure HfO2. Annealing above 750 °C resulted in crystalline monoclinic HfO2 with a density of 9 g/cm3 and a refractive index of 2.10. The study also investigated the chemical mechanisms and structural properties of the films using various analytical techniques.
